23.19

The Ruins of Maddlow Castle

Region: The Barrier Range

Connects to [24.13](/wiki/24-13/), [25.17](/wiki/25-17/), *[26.20](/wiki/26-20/), [29.14.17](/wiki/29-14/)* and the **Duchy of Thring**.

In a high valley at the center of the Witch Clans' domains, there is a place that they call a ruin but is more accurately the opposite of a ruin - a castle that was only ever half built and then abandoned. Long ago, this place was the seat of power for [The Maddlows](/wiki/the-maddlows/).

The reason that the castle was never fully built is that each Maddlow suspected the others of inserting secret doors and traps into the design.

Connection

*<p lang="en-US" style="margin-bottom:0.14in">Gischard Penderghast (24.13) looted Maddlow Castle some time ago and left its walls perilously full of holes.</p>

Hooks

*<p lang="en-US" style="margin-bottom:0.14in">Any truth to the Maddlows’ fears about traps and secret passages?</p> Category:Hex Category:The Barrier Range
